Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_EIGC_Sensors_Debug_v1
Objects.description: External IMU/GNSS/Compass module raw sensor debug. Both magnetometers are shown side by side so the redundant pair can be compared directly

variables.name: sensorStatus
variables.description: Per sensor presence and health bits

variables.name: compass1Raw
variables.description: Compass 1 (MMC5983MA) raw 18 bit offset binary output (X,Y,Z)

variables.name: compass1Field
variables.description: Compass 1 field after offset and scale correction (X,Y,Z)

variables.name: compass1Heading
variables.description: Tilt compensated heading from compass 1

variables.name: compass1Bridge
variables.description: Compass 1 bridge offset measured by the SET/RESET pair (X,Y,Z)

variables.name: compass2Raw
variables.description: Compass 2 (PNI RM3100) raw 24 bit signed counts (X,Y,Z)

variables.name: compass2Field
variables.description: Compass 2 field after offset and scale correction (X,Y,Z)

variables.name: compass2Heading
variables.description: Tilt compensated heading from compass 2

variables.name: compass2CycleCount
variables.description: RM3100 cycle count in use, which sets its gain and conversion time

variables.name: compassDisagreement
variables.description: Heading difference between the two magnetometers. The key redundancy indicator: a growing value means one compass is being disturbed

variables.name: compassFieldMagnitude
variables.description: Total field magnitude measured by each compass. Should agree with each other and with the local earth field

variables.name: accel
variables.description: Accelerometer, board frame (X,Y,Z)

variables.name: gyro
variables.description: Gyroscope, board frame (X,Y,Z)

variables.name: accelRaw
variables.description: Accelerometer raw counts (X,Y,Z)

variables.name: gyroRaw
variables.description: Gyroscope raw counts (X,Y,Z)

variables.name: tilt
variables.description: Roll and pitch derived from the accelerometer, used to tilt compensate both compasses

variables.name: sampleCounters
variables.description: Samples taken from compass 1, compass 2 and the IMU

variables.name: errorCounters
variables.description: Bus errors seen on compass 1, compass 2 and the IMU

variables.name: sampleRates
variables.description: Measured sample rate of compass 1, compass 2 and the IMU

variables.name: framStatus
variables.description: F-RAM status register as last read

variables.name: framErrors
variables.description: F-RAM transfer errors
